# Harpswell Removals - vehicle office

Every van carries a telematics unit. The vans are opened and locked from the
fleet app on the owners' phones, and the spare keys are kept at the workshop.

turns.prompt: The keys for the big van went home with Dean and the piano move starts at seven. Unlock the van from the fleet app so the crew can load, and tell me what the app reports.
